subject: POC replan: add returns autocategorization + evaluation guardrails
messages:
From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alicia Gomez <alicia@heliomart.com>, Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@heliomart.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Feb 2027 15:12:00 -0500
Subject: Recap & proposed POC plan — HelioMart discovery (next steps)

Hi Alicia / Tom — thanks for taking the time today. Quick recap from our discovery and a proposed POC plan so we can lock timelines and owners. Please comment if anything below is off.

1) Key goals you called out
- Improve search relevance on category + product pages (reduce null-result clicks)
- Surface prioritized FAQ answers for CS agents (reduce avg handle time)
- Better automated routing for returns (new ask in call)

2) Proposed POC scope (4 weeks) — initial + stretch
- Core (week 0–3):
  • Intent & relevance model for product and category search; evaluation on open set (click-through uplift target: +8%).
  • Agent FAQ assistant (top-50 intents) with precision @1 >= 75% as measured on your test prompts.
- Stretch (optional):
  • Returns autocategorization pipeline (classify returns by reason + suggested disposition).

3) Success criteria & evaluation plan
- Shared evaluation harness (we’ll run side-by-side A/B tests where possible).
- Pass gates: search CTR uplift >= 6% on the validation bucket OR model demonstrates improved NDCG over baseline; FAQ precision@1 >= 75% on your labeled set.
- For returns: target macro-F1 >= 0.70 (stretch — can be gated).

4) Timeline & owners
- Kickoff: propose Mon, Feb 22 (30–45m) — data handoff, security review kickoff, and sprint plan.
- Data owner: HelioMart — Tom (ingest + sample export)
- POC owner (Redwood): Marissa Cole
- Model/infra lead (Redwood): Karthik Iyer

5) Next steps (actionable)
- HelioMart: share sample export (product catalog + search logs) and data_inventory.csv by Fri Feb 19.
- Redwood: send POC-outline.docx and shared Drive folder; draft SOW and access checklist.
- Schedule kickoff on Mon Feb 22 (Marissa to send calendar invite).

Attachments: POC-outline.docx (summary plan), data_inventory.csv (expected schema stub)

Thanks — I’ll follow up with the Drive link and hubspot deal reference.

—
Logan Wright
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
logan.wright@redwoodinference.com

From: Alicia Gomez <alicia@heliomart.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@heliomart.com>
Date: Fri, 19 Feb 2027 09:37:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Recap & proposed POC plan — HelioMart discovery (next steps)

Thanks Logan — this is helpful. Two quick clarifications from our side:

1) Returns use case: during the call we realized returns volume is a key downstream cost driver. We want the autocategorization included in the initial test window (not only a stretch) but with a reduced scope — start with "Reason" and "Disposition" (3 top categories each). If possible, can we treat that as a parallel mini-pipeline so it doesn’t block search/FAQ?

2) Security/data retention: attached is our sec_requirements.pdf with minimum KMS and retention limits. Can Redwood confirm whether customer-managed keys (KMS) are doable for the POC and what logs we can expect to see (audit + request traces)?

3) Acceptance metrics: for search please state whether CTR uplift is measured site-wide or on a test cohort. We’d prefer a cohort evaluation to control seasonality.

We’ll push sample exports by EOD Monday. Also attaching a short Doc with expected labeling cadence — we can label ~2k FAQ pairs in the first week.

Attachments: sec_requirements.pdf (HelioMart security brief)

Alicia Gomez
Head of Product Operations | HelioMart
alicia@heliomart.com

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alicia Gomez <alicia@heliomart.com>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Feb 2027 08:53:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Recap & proposed POC plan — HelioMart discovery (next steps)

Thanks Alicia — good notes. Quick proposal to keep momentum while addressing HelioMart’s ask:

- Scope change: move Returns autocategorization from "stretch" to "parallel core" but with reduced label scope (3 reasons x 3 dispositions to start). We’ll run it as a separate pipeline that consumes the same extract but is evaluated independently — it will not block the search/FAQ rollout gate.

- Evaluation guardrails: we’ll measure search CTR uplift on a randomized cohort (10% test bucket) to control for seasonality. We will also run offline NDCG tests on the held-out query set you provide. FAQ precision will be measured on the labeled 2k sample you mentioned.

- Acceptance thresholds (proposal):
  • Search CTR uplift (cohort): >= 6% uplift over baseline OR NDCG improvement >= 0.03 (whichever is met first).
  • FAQ precision@1: >= 75% on labeled set.
  • Returns macro-F1: >= 0.68 for the initial 3-category run (we can tighten after week 3).

- Owners & timeline update:
  • Marissa to take POC lead (contact and weekly status).
  • Karthik to lead model tuning and orchestration.
  • We can compress the plan by one week if HelioMart can deliver the sample export + security checklist by Mon Feb 22 end-of-day (we’ll start data ingest Tue).

Quoted for context:
> On Fri, Feb 19, 2027 at 09:37 AM Alicia Gomez <alicia@heliomart.com> wrote:
> > Thanks Logan — this is helpful. Two quick clarifications from our side...

Marissa — I’m happy to draft the updated acceptance matrix and push updated plan/Drive artifacts ahead of the kickoff. Confirming we’ll still do a short kickoff Monday (30–45m) to align on data transfer channels and immediate blockers.

-Karthik
Model & Solutions Lead | Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com

Date: Mon, 22 Feb 2027 14:03:00 -0500
Subject: Finalized: updated POC plan + kickoff (Mon Feb 22)

Alicia / Tom — thanks for the quick responses and for sending the security brief. Per Karthik’s suggestion we updated the plan and acceptance guardrails. Short confirmation below and concrete next steps prior to kickoff: 

Summary of changes
- Returns autocategorization promoted to parallel core (reduced label set; independent evaluation).
- Evaluation: cohort-based CTR uplift measurement + offline NDCG; FAQ measured on your 2k labeled set.
- Acceptance thresholds as proposed by Karthik.

Immediate checklist (before kickoff)
- HelioMart (Tom/Alicia): upload sample export + data_inventory.csv and sec_requirements.pdf to the shared Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1PoCShared. Deadline: Mon Feb 22 12:00PM PT.
- Redwood (Marissa): calendar invite sent for 30m kickoff at Mon Feb 22 2:00PM PT; Drive + initial SOW uploaded.
- Both: DocuSign link for NDA/POC SOW will be shared after kickoff if no additional legal blockers.

Attachments uploaded: updated_poc_plan.xlsx (detailed sprint plan + acceptance matrix)

If we get the sample data by noon PT we’ll start the ingest Tuesday and aim to have an initial baseline evaluation by next Friday. If HelioMart needs the returns work deprioritized, tell us in the kickoff and we’ll revert to the original stretch plan.

Looking forward — Marissa will run the kickoff and send the notes.
